svg.title: Figure 07 · Trading-cost sensitivity
svg.desc: Same synthetic market, signal, sizing and common evaluation interval. Cost is an all-in proportional deduction per one-way traded notional; initial investment is charged. Cash earns 2% effective annually. This is not a calibrated broker or market-impact model.
